key.description: The build key of the entry (build_layout.h buildKey): the hash, or the hash and the digest of the georeference of a model or a splat that has one. The marker is the entry's: a copy of the file in another folder has its own

retryAfter.description: When DDBBuild with pendingOnly (and no force) retries the build: lastAttempt + libddb's retry backoff, Unix epoch seconds (integer); due when now >= retryAfter. Applies only when awaitingFiles is false

awaitingFiles.description: missingDependencies is not empty: no timer retries the build; adding a file of one of those names releases it (then false, due at once)
